title: RAM Went Up. CPU Didn't.
caption:
My hosting bill is going up because of AI, and I don't ship any AI.

Fly.io emailed customers on Sept 21: from October 1, memory is $6 per GB a month on every preset, up from about $5. CPU pricing doesn't move. Hetzner already did its second round in June, where one US cloud VM went from $46.49 to $141.49. OVHcloud's founder says he now pays 6x what he paid for RAM a year ago.

The admission: I've been sizing boxes by cores for years, out of habit. Cores turn out to be the part holding steady. Memory is where the bill moved, and I never looked at that line once.

What are you running on?
